name: Merritt Reservoir SRA - Willow Cove Campground
note: Campground on the east shore of Merritt Reservoir SRA, ~1 km south of the dam on its own spur off the dam road; the pads and loop road are packed sand. Vault toilets and a hydrant here; the park's shower building is at Cedar Bay. Park entry permit required. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: NGPC 'Willow Cove Campground' map (outdoornebraska.gov PDF, July 2025, via Wayback capture 2026-09-27): 27 numbered drive-in sites on a loop road (21 Electric Plus, 6 Basic; 10-15 and 24-26 reservable) + ReserveAmerica park 232201 loop 'Willow Cove Campground' read 2026-11-05: 9 Electric Plus sites (010-015, 024-026), Drive-In, Back-In, 50 A, Max Vehicle Length 40-60 ft, 'Driveway Surface: Sand' (packed-sand pads in a developed loop, passes the AWH 2026-11-05 sand rule); calendar shows them FCFS ('W') to Apr 30 and bookable online ('A') from May 1 2027 -> real NGPC drive-in RV campground. Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: NGPC Willow Cove campground map (July 2025) draws Electric Plus sites 7-13 as back-in spurs off the shore side of the loop road ending ~15-30 m (by its 200-ft scale bar) from the mapped shoreline, with open ground between, and Basic 16-20 between the road and the shore; ReserveAmerica per-site records 010-013 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront', 'Shoreline site: Y', 'Distance from Shoreline: 10'. Satellite: Esri World Imagery 2024-03-09 (export + z18 tiles at 42.6224,-100.8642) shows open packed sand from the spur ends to the water, ~10-15 m, with only scattered leafless shoreline trees, no road, parking or day-use strip between; the fishing pier sits at the SW end of that row (site 13). Dam check: Merritt Dam ~1.1 km N, campground on the reservoir side; USGS 3DEP 899.3-900.9 m at the sites vs 897.6 m on the open water (2-3 m above the lake, a low bank, not a bluff or below pool).

fees.note: In season: basic $15, electric plus $30 a night; $5 less mid-October through April. Plus tax, the $8.50 reservation fee when booked online, and a park entry permit ($7 a day for a Nebraska vehicle, $14 otherwise; $35 / $70 a year). Nebraska Game and Parks' camping rates grid ('These rates are consistent across all parks').

fees_source: https://outdoornebraska.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/2025-Camping-Rates-Grid.pdf (row 'Merritt SRA', statewide Electric Plus $30 / Basic $15) as already carried by sibling entries 2716/2717; entry permit amounts from the ReserveAmerica Willow Cove site pages' alert, read 2026-11-05
flags: Not on RV Life (Algolia bbox around Merritt returns only Boardman and Cedar Bay), so no rating.

Pin is the centroid of the 27 mapped sites (NGPC map georeferenced to the fishing pier); RA's GIS points for 010-015/024-026 sit ~50-100 m SW of where the NGPC map draws them. ~2.9 km NE of Cedar Bay 2717, 4.9 km from Boardman 2716.
Elevation: Open-Meteo gives 896 m at the pin (coarse DEM blending the lake); 3DEP gives 900.4 m there.

Structured data for the next pass: hookups electric 50 (RA, reservable sites; the NGPC legend says 20/30 A generically), no water or sewer at the site; sites.count 27, max_rig_ft 60 (RA site 015), all back-in; booking reservable on ReserveAmerica May 1 - Sep 30 for sites 10-15 and 24-26 (180-day window), the rest FCFS; open year round per the RA park page.

RA's loop notes (every Willow Cove site page) still say 'This campground loop is all first-come, first-serve. Reservations are taken for ... Cedar Bay and Beed's Landing', which contradicts its own calendar ('A' from May 1 2027) and the NGPC map; the notes also list 'Proposed Extended Stay Area' - worth a look if NGPC turns the loop into long-stay sites.
Sand: RA lists 'Driveway Surface: Sand' for all 9 reservable sites; satellite shows a developed numbered loop with packed sand pads, not open-beach camping (AWH 2026-11-05 rule: fine).
